name: Winner_1
short_caption: The robot enthusiastically raises its right arm into a victory fist while tilting its head up.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture and raises its right arm high above its head with a closed fist. Simultaneously, its head tilts upward and slightly to the left, looking toward its raised hand. It holds this victorious pose for a couple of seconds before lowering its arm and returning its head to face forward, ending in the neutral posture.
safety_notes: The right arm extends fully upward and slightly outward, requiring clear overhead clearance.
